exposure: Implementation of a postpartum hemorrhage management bundle
outcome: maternal blood product transfusion (frequency, type, amount)
cohort: All patients >=18 years of age and at >20 weeks' gestation who delivered at a single safety net teaching hospital between October 2017 and December 2019.
finding: The implementation of the postpartum hemorrhage bundle did not decrease the overall prevalence of maternal blood product transfusion but was associated with higher rates of utilization of resources like intrauterine balloon placement.
